title: Eddoboozi ly'Amagezi
intro: Eddoboozi ery’amagezi erigonvu edda lyagabana okubuulirira okusukkulumye ku biseera. Omuwendo guno, ogwaweebwa omukisa okutegeera okw’amaanyi, gwayisa eby’okuyiga eby’omuwendo ennyo ebisigala nga ttaala eri bonna abeegomba obulagirizi. Osobola okuzuula ekituufu ekiri emabega w’ebigambo bino ebiwangaala?
clues: Naweebwa omukisa ogw’amaanyi okuva ewa Allah, ekirabo ekyatangaaza omutima n’ebirowoozo byange.
Nakyukira omwana wange omwagalwa, nga njagala okugabana eky’obugagga ekisinga okuba eky’omuwendo kye nnalina.
Nalabula nti obutali bwenkanya obusinga obunene kwe kuteekawo emikwano ne Katonda Omu ow’amazima.
Najjukiza nti n’obuzito bwa mukene, nga bukwekeddwa munda mu lwazi oba emitala w’eggulu, Allah ajja kuvunaanibwa.
Nalagira okubeera n’obuvunaanyizibwa eri abazadde, wadde ng’obuwulize buli mu nsonga z’obutuukirivu zokka.
Nayigiriza empisa ennyangu: tambula n’obwetoowaze ku nsi era otereeze eddoboozi lyo; kubanga eddoboozi erisinga obukambwe lye ddoboozi ery’endogoyi.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
